purpose: The ONE map of which host owns which child sitemap. One Pages deployment answers both hosts from one tree, so the static sitemap.xml and robots.txt name both children; functions/_lib/host_crawl_surfaces.js narrows them per request host, and scripts/lib/sitemap_index.mjs writes the static index from this same list. Guarded by scripts/validators/validate_host_crawl_surfaces.mjs.
origin: Until 11 Oct 2026 both hosts served one sitemap index and one robots.txt naming both hosts' child sitemaps. Search Console rejects a cross-host child (HTTP 400 'Could not process sitemap' in the portfolio sitemaps run 38142618891) and the coverage run inspected the other host's URLs in each property (109 of 110 Spry inspections 403 'You do not own this site').
